See crypto-media/media-service-binding.md §3 and crypto-media/call-state.md §4.1. v1 uses the single scheme ak.media.participant_binding.v1.

issuer_kid.description: DID URL (with fragment) of the token issuer service signing key. MUST resolve to a service DID present in the current-epoch ak.realm.media_service.service_id.

data_classes.description: Closed machine-checkable classes of plaintext or reversible derived content this service may receive. Human-readable purposes do not replace this field.

policy_action_state_payload.description: Policy action-log payload. Exactly one policy_id or action_id is present and becomes the registered coalesce subject.

policy_rule_state_payload.description: Policy rule state payload. rule_id is the stable ak.component.policy.rule.v1 cell subject and MUST equal the rule_id of the PolicyRule this event asserts, whose closed shape is defined by policy.schema.json #/$defs/policy_rule (zh/models/governance-objects.md section 5). The cell is an ordered_log, so each accepted event appends one revision rather than replacing the previous one.

rule_id.description: Rule identifier, same lexical form as policy.schema.json #/$defs/policy_rule rule_id.

policy_set_state_payload.description: Policy definition state payload. policy_id is the stable policy cell subject.

profile_realm_override_payload.description: Realm-scoped actor profile override payload for ak.profile.realm_override. target_ref is the Actor Profile being overridden; target_realm_id is the Realm where the override applies.

reaction_encrypted_payload_plaintext.description: Plaintext JSON encrypted into reaction_payload.encrypted_payload.ciphertext for ak.reaction.add / ak.reaction.remove in E2EE realms. The outer reaction_payload.key remains required and carries the service-visible routing tag; this plaintext carries the real reaction key and optional user content.

key.description: Canonical reaction key after client-side normalization: a single NFC Unicode emoji cluster or profile-registered short tag. This is the real reaction key, not the outer HMAC routing tag.

annotation.description: Optional user-visible annotation associated with the reaction.

remove_add_event_ids.description: Optional client-side convergence accelerator for ak.reaction.remove: add event ids that this remove intends to tombstone. MUST be omitted on ak.reaction.add. Service-side reducers still rely on the outer event actor_id, target_ref, key, and causal frontier.

reaction_payload.description: Reducer input for ak.reaction.add and ak.reaction.remove. The cell is a core OR-Set of reaction assertions and both kinds project one or_set_add; default-view membership is keyed on (actor_id, target_ref, key), and a remove tombstones every add from the same actor with the same key that is not strictly causally later than it, which includes the adds concurrent with it. See zh/models/strand-and-message.md §9.8 for the authoritative Reaction model (target scope, OR-Set, authz, anti-abuse) and zh/crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md §2.9 for the plaintext-vs-encrypted policy.

key.description: Reaction key. Plaintext realms SHOULD use a single Unicode emoji cluster or registered short tag. End-to-end-encrypted realms with `aad_visibility != opaque_id` MUST carry the v1 keyed-HMAC routing tag here (`HMAC-SHA256(key = MLS-Exporter("arkret-reaction-routing-v1", context = realm_id), data = NFC(canonical_emoji))`), naturally bound to the current MLS group + epoch via the exporter secret; see zh/crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md §2.9 for the authoritative construction. This lets OR-Set dedup, rate-limit and reducer convergence keep working without revealing the chosen emoji; the canonical emoji travels in `encrypted_payload`.

annotation.description: Optional free-form annotation (e.g. issue triage label). MUST be omitted when `encrypted_payload` is present; in E2EE realms the annotation MUST instead be carried inside `encrypted_payload`.

encrypted_payload.description: Encrypted carrier for the canonical reaction key and any annotation in E2EE realms. The decrypted plaintext JSON MUST validate as #/$defs/reaction_encrypted_payload_plaintext. When present, outer plaintext `key` MUST be the routing tag and `annotation` MUST be omitted; service-side OR-Set convergence still uses the outer routing key.

read_receipt_policy_payload.$comment: Payload for ak.realm.read_receipt_policy. Closed object so typos in receipt_compliance_opt_in or its sub-fields cause schema_violation. The enclosing Event carries realm_id; payload does not duplicate it. minProperties=1 rejects an empty no-op policy. Compliance exceptions exist only as sub-fields of receipt_compliance_opt_in; absent object / absent sub-field / false all mean not opted in. See zh/discovery/read-receipts.md §2.5.1.

receipt_compliance_opt_in.description: Structured compliance opt-in object replacing the three former parallel boolean escape switches. Absent object means nothing is opted in. Each sub-field defaults to false; absent / false / misspelled sub-fields all mean NOT opted in, so the reducer MUST treat them as reject (fail-closed). forced_public_world_readable_receipts is a SECOND gate on top of public_receipts_on_world_readable (the former being true does not relieve the latter). Closed object (additionalProperties=false) so unrecognized sub-fields are rejected with schema_violation at wire-parse time. See zh/discovery/read-receipts.md §2.5.1.

child_privacy_tightening_against_require.description: Privacy-floor escape switch. When the parent policy sets disclosure='required' and this is true, a child Realm MAY tighten disclosure to 'optional' or 'disabled'; otherwise the reducer rejects with read_receipt_compliance_floor_violated.

public_receipts_on_world_readable.description: Opt-in for the visibility='public' + history_visibility='world_readable' combination. When false the reducer MUST reject that combination (read_receipt_visibility_combination_invalid); when true it admits the combination with a warning diagnostic.

forced_public_world_readable_receipts.description: Second opt-in for disclosure='required' + visibility='public' + history_visibility='world_readable'. The reducer MUST reject the forced public world-readable combination (read_receipt_forced_public_world_readable_forbidden) unless this is true in addition to public_receipts_on_world_readable=true.

alias.description: Canonical realm alias <localpart>:<domain> (zh/discovery/object-addressing.md §3.3). Sigil-free: the display forms #general:acme.example and general@acme.example MUST NOT reach the wire. <domain> is the issuing authority and MUST be an authority domain of this Realm's trust_domain; a foreign-domain claim MUST be rejected with reason realm_alias_authority_mismatch.

realm_alias_payload.description: Closed payload for ak.realm.alias, the ONLY wire carrier of a Realm alias. A declaration writes the complete canonical alias; {tombstone:true} is a durable value tombstone that removes the alias from effective resolution without erasing the cell history. realm.schema.json is closed and has no alias property, and ak.realm.create / ak.realm.update payloads MUST NOT carry one.

realm_authority_basis_update_payload.description: ak.realm.authority.basis_update — re-anchor the authority-root capability-action registry digest. The root basis never drifts with a software version: a controller adopts a new capability surface explicitly, and historical Seals keep resolving against the digest they were issued under. It changes neither controller nor generation and never retroactively widens an existing grant.

expected_state_digest.description: JCS SHA-256 digest of the authority-root cell value this Event expects to replace. The reducer MUST compare-and-swap against it and reject a stale value rather than overwrite.

capability_action_registry_digest.description: JCS SHA-256 digest of a retrievable, recomputable, compatible and active capability-action-registry.json snapshot. An unknown or incompatible snapshot MUST fail closed.

patch.description: The authority-root members this Event changes. Every member absent here is preserved verbatim by the reducer.

realm_authority_reset_payload.description: ak.realm.authority.reset — advance the authority generation. Every grant anchored to the previous generation fails at read time without any cascading write. Destructive: this is not how a controller hands the Realm over, and it MUST carry an independent confirmation.

expected_state_digest.description: JCS SHA-256 digest of the authority-root cell value this Event expects to replace. The reducer MUST compare-and-swap against it and reject a stale value rather than overwrite.

authority_generation.description: MUST equal the expected value's authority_generation + 1.

patch.description: The authority-root members this Event changes. Every member absent here is preserved verbatim by the reducer.

destructive_confirmation.description: Explicit confirmation token. A reset discards an entire authority tree, so it MUST NOT be reachable by replaying a transfer body.

realm_create_payload.description: Create payload uses the full Realm object schema for wire validation. Semantic validation MUST require payload.object.created_by to match the top-level actor_id and payload.object.created_at to match the top-level created_at before acceptance. payload.object.capability_action_registry_digest MUST resolve to a retrievable capability-action-registry.json snapshot whose RFC 8785 JCS recomputation matches, and the reducer MUST copy that signed value verbatim into the ak.component.realm.authority_root.v1 cell rather than inferring it from its own embedded registry. All five registered cell writes defined by zh/models/realm-and-space.md section 2.5 are one atomic unit; any of them failing rejects the whole create.

realm_digest_suite_transition_payload.description: Payload for ak.realm.digest_suite_transition under ak.profile.hash_transition.v1. The containing Transition Seal commits the pre-transition governance view with previous_state_root and the post-transition view with state_root.

read_trigger_window_ms.description: Maximum wait window for on_last_read aggregate contributions. If omitted, implementations MUST use max_ttl_ms. This window is metadata-only and MUST NOT expose reader identity or unread reader count.

effective_scope.description: Tagged scope of the key material. Realm-default history uses {kind:'realm', realm_id}; Circle history uses {kind:'circle', realm_id, circle_id}. Implementations MUST NOT infer key scope from strand_id or track.

policy_digest.description: Hash of the effective Realm/Circle policy root that is the basis of this delivery decision. For ak.realm_key.share it is the root authorising the historical key delivery. For ak.realm_key.withheld it is the root the source actually evaluated when refusing delivery; it pins the refusal basis and does NOT assert that the share was ever authorised. The source MUST resolve a single effective root on the Event CBA/T0 basis and MUST NOT emit a durable withheld with a zero value, the receiver-current root or an implementation placeholder.

membership_frontier_digest.description: Optional hash of the membership frontier evaluated for history visibility and recipient membership.

share_kind.description: Discriminator for the key-share target. member_device seals history_secret material to a concrete authorized recipient device. realm_recovery_key seals the same material to a durability_policy RecoveryRecipient RRK verification method (crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md §2.10.8).

recipient_principal_id.description: For member_device shares, the member principal receiving the history key. For realm_recovery_key shares, the durability_policy.recovery_recipients[].principal_id that published the RRK verification method.

recipient_device_id.description: Required only for share_kind=member_device. The concrete authorized recipient device whose HPKE public key receives the sealed history_secret material.

recipient_verification_method.description: Required only for share_kind=realm_recovery_key. DID URL of the RRK HPKE public key, equal to durability_policy.recovery_recipients[].verification_method and designated by an active ArkretRealmHistoryRecoveryKey service entry in recipient_principal_id's DID Document.

recovery_recipient_id.description: Required only for share_kind=realm_recovery_key. Stable durability_policy.recovery_recipients[].recipient_id covered by this RRK seal.

source_authorization_ref.description: Accepted policy/grant/source-authorisation Control Move proving that sender_device_id may deliver this share_kind and key_scope to the named recipient at the Event CBA basis. It is covered by sender_device_signature and MUST be independently verified before installing history_secret material.

sender_device_signature.description: Detached device signature over the canonical share transcript fixed by crypto-media/device-lifecycle.md 13. The transcript carries context "ak.realm-key-share-sender-proof-v1" and binds share_kind, sender_device_id, source_authorization_ref, recipient_principal_id, the selected variant target fields (recipient_device_id OR recipient_verification_method + recovery_recipient_id), key_scope, exactly one of ciphertext / encrypted_key_ref, aad_digest?, expires_at? and created_at. Unselected branch fields, the unselected material field and absent optional fields MUST be omitted from the transcript and MUST NOT be written as null.

share_kind.description: Discriminator shared with realm_key_share_payload so both kinds derive the same ak.component.realm_key.delivery.v1 cell subject. v1 registers member_device only: durable realm_recovery_key withheld semantics are not defined (crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md 2.10.8 handles RRK seal failure through fail-closed error paths).

source_authorization_ref.description: Accepted policy/grant/source-authorisation Control Move proving that sender_device_id may decide delivery for this recipient, target and key_scope at the Event CBA basis. A withheld carries subject-level terminal semantics, so receivers MUST verify it and reject the Event with late_recovery_share_not_authorized when it is missing or does not cover the decision.

realm_notary_payload.description: Payload for ak.realm.notary. The enclosing Control Move MUST CAS the current ak.component.notary.v1 head and the current notary authority MUST finalize the containing Seal.

realm_organization_payload.description: Organization-side endorsement or revocation for a Realm relationship. Reducer validation MUST require realm_id to match the top-level Event.realm_id, organization_id to resolve to an Organization principal, the Realm-side writer to hold ak.realm.admin, and authorization to verify against the organization DID control state or a delegated service whose purpose covers this relationship and control_scopes.

statement_id.description: Stable id of this organization statement. It is audit identity, not the reducer cell subject; the reducer cell subject is (organization_id, relationship).

realm_id.description: Realm the organization statement is bound to. MUST equal the enclosing Event.realm_id.

organization_id.description: Organization principal DID that endorses, governs, sponsors, certifies, or revokes the Realm relationship.

relationship.description: Relationship being asserted or revoked for this organization and Realm.

control_scopes.description: Machine-readable scopes covered by the organization's consent. A scope here is an endorsement boundary only; actual Realm control still requires the corresponding Realm policy, notary, capability, or service-binding event.

expires_at.description: Administrative review/renewal hint only. It does not auto-transition account status; a later explicit ak.account.status event is required and remains subject to supersedes and terminal rules.

realm_frontier_digest.description: Optional digest of the Realm control frontier the organization evaluated when issuing this statement.

organization_policy_ref.description: Optional DID-document delegation URL, policy object, governance decision, or attestation reference used to evaluate the statement.

authorization.description: Organization-side authorization proof. This is independent of the Realm-side ak.realm.admin authorization required to write the event into Realm history.

issuer.description: Organization DID or delegated service DID that issued this statement.

delegation_ref.description: Required when issuer_role is governance_service or account_authority. It MUST resolve to a live organization DID delegation whose purpose covers ak.realm.organization and the requested relationship/control_scopes.

executed_by.description: Optional human administrator or service principal that initiated the organization-side decision. This does not become the organization principal.

proof.description: Signature, threshold transcript, or governance-service attestation over the canonical organization statement binding statement_id, realm_id, organization_id, relationship, status, control_scopes, issued_at, validity window, and statement replacement/revocation fields.

realm_owner_transfer_payload.description: ak.realm.owner.transfer — rotate the controller binding of the Realm authority-root cell. It changes controller_id and increments controller_epoch only: authority_generation, the cell ref and every existing grant are untouched, so the whole authority tree issued by the previous controller stays valid. This is not a reparent — the root never moves.

expected_state_digest.description: JCS SHA-256 digest of the authority-root cell value this Event expects to replace. The reducer MUST compare-and-swap against it and reject a stale value rather than overwrite.

controller_id.description: The successor principal that becomes the root controller.

controller_epoch.description: MUST equal the expected value's controller_epoch + 1.

patch.description: The authority-root members this Event changes. Every member absent here is preserved verbatim by the reducer.

successor_acceptance.description: Independent acceptance proof from the successor. The current controller proof, this proof, the payload and the expected root value MUST all enter the same signing transcript, so neither party can be bound to a transfer it did not see.

realm_policy_bundle_payload.$comment: Payload for ak.realm.policy_bundle — the payload IS this flat closed object (not a state_payload wrapper); event-envelope.schema.json dispatches the kind directly to this def, and the def name follows the ak.<x> -> <x>_payload derivation rule. The closed property set is the complete set of Realm policy components that have no independent facet Event kind. Components that DO have their own kind and cell (ak.realm.join_rule, ak.realm.history_visibility, ak.realm.read_receipt_policy, ak.realm.asset_privacy_policy, ak.realm.delivery_binding_policy, ak.realm.moderation_policy, ak.realm.media_service, ak.realm.plaintext_visible_services, ...) are written by those events and are already covered by policy_root's ak.component.realm.*policy* leaf filter; they MUST NOT be echoed here.
realm_policy_bundle_payload.description: Enabled Realm policy component set, written wholesale into the ak.component.realm.policy_bundle.v1 cas_register cell: every revision restates the complete enabled component set and the Realm object's derived policy fields re-derive from the latest accepted bundle. policy_revision is strictly monotonic; the reducer rejects rollback or gaps, and policy_frontier_digest MUST cover policy_revision (see contract-registry event-kind row and models/realm-and-space.md sections 2.3/2.3.1).

policy_revision.description: Strictly monotonic bundle revision; rollback or gaps are rejected.

aad_visibility.$comment: One registered axis in v1. The AAD field set has exactly one wire discriminator, encrypted-envelope.schema.json#/properties/aad_visibility_event_id; the object shape leaves room for a second registered axis without renaming the component, and additionalProperties=false hard-rejects unregistered axis names at wire parse time.

event_id.description: Realm ceiling on encrypted-envelope aad_visibility_event_id. Disclosure order is hidden < routing_digest < opaque_id; an envelope MUST NOT declare a wider value than this ceiling, and a receiver that sees one MUST reject it with reason_code aad_visibility_policy_violation. An envelope MAY declare a narrower value. Absent component means the hidden ceiling, so routing_digest and opaque_id are only reachable after the Realm declares them. See crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md sections 2.3.2 and 2.8.

mls_send_pause.description: Declaring advisory downgrades the MLS send pause from MUST to SHOULD and is only accepted when the Realm declares ak.profile.e2ee_relaxed.v1 (crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md section 2.4.1); omitting the field in a later revision reverts to the strict default.

relaxed_window_max_ms.description: Declared ak.profile.e2ee_relaxed.v1 removed-member decryption window. Omitting it means the 30000 ms default. The 300000 ms absolute ceiling is enforced by the reducer and independently by every receiver with reason_code relaxed_window_exceeds_ceiling, NOT by this schema: a wire value above the ceiling MUST surface as that reason code rather than schema_violation, and receivers MUST NOT silently clamp it. See crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md section 2.4.1.
relaxed_window_max_ms.$comment: Deliberately unbounded above; ak.vector.e2ee_relaxed.window_exceeds_ceiling.v1 requires 300001 to reach the reducer.

media_service_decrypts.description: Whether a media service listed in plaintext_visible_services may decrypt call media. Defaults to false when absent. It is one of three conditions that MUST all hold (ak.realm.media_service declaration + plaintext_visible_services grant + this toggle). Because it changes who may receive media keys, it enters the media scope security_frontier_digest; a generation that does not cover the current value cannot authorize media decryption. See crypto-media/media-service-binding.md section 8.2.

member_action.description: How this Realm disposes of a principal's membership when the account enters deactivated. Defaults to leave_self_initiated when the component is absent. Unrecognized values fail closed to retain_membership with a policy parse warning and MUST NOT silently fall back to the default. The single authority for the closed enum and its disposition semantics is identity/account-lifecycle.md section 7.1.

require_consent.description: When true, every invite into this Realm MUST pass the holder consent admission gate in identity/consent-model.md section 6.1 before the invite Control Move is submitted. It MUST NOT be read as permission for a cross-Realm CBA precondition.

allowed_third_party_invite_verification_.description: Complete current allow-set of service DIDs trusted to attest 3PID ownership for ak.invite.third_party / ak.invite.claim. The array is whole-value replacement state in this policy-bundle revision, not an incremental patch. Absence and [] both deny every third-party invite verification service. Removing a DID in a later policy_revision revokes it for every later claim re-check; no separate tombstone exists. Reducers MUST evaluate the current accepted bundle cell on a fresh basis before accepting ak.invite.claim.

realm_policy_server_payload.description: Closed payload for ak.realm.policy_server. A declaration writes the complete direct Realm binding; {tombstone:true} is a durable value tombstone that removes the direct binding from effective queries without erasing the cell history.

leakage_class.description: Machine-readable search leakage class. ak.profile.search.blind_index.v1 uses deterministic_token; ak.profile.search.forward_private.v1 requires forward_private; access_hiding is reserved for explicit PIR/ORAM-backed profiles.

token_rotation_cadence_ms.description: Maximum intended interval between search token generations for profiles that rotate index keys or OPRF blinds.

realm_set_default_strand_payload.description: Payload for ak.realm.set_default_strand. Sets / changes the Realm's authoritative default discussion Strand pointer. Reducer projects strand_id into the Realm projection default_strand_id (single authoritative pointer; avoids multi-default dirty state). Reducer MUST verify strand_id references a projected, non-tombstoned Strand in this Realm; a dangling reference MUST be rejected with failed_precondition. The Strand projection is_default is a derived marker (strand_id == realm.default_strand_id), never independent storage. expected_default_strand_id compiles to a cell head_eq precondition for optimistic concurrency (CAS). Absent and explicit null are normalized to the same null value before comparison, so omission asserts head_eq null and is only valid while the cell is still in its initial no-default state; once a default is set the field MUST be present, otherwise the reducer MUST reject with failed_precondition and MUST NOT overwrite unconditionally.

expected_default_strand_id.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard compared as a whole value after absent and explicit null are normalized to null. The reducer accepts the write only if the Realm's current default_strand_id equals this value (null asserts no default is currently set). Omission therefore asserts head_eq null and MUST fail once a default exists. Mismatch MUST be rejected (failed_precondition).

realm_upgrade_state_payload.description: Realm reducer-profile upgrade state payload. target_reducer_profile is the ak.component.realm.upgrade.v1 cas_register cell subject. Schema and reducer requirements travel in the Event Envelope requirements.{schema, reducer} fields, not here (zh/conformance/conformance-suite.md section 2).

target_reducer_profile.description: Reducer profile id this Realm upgrades to. Same lexical form as the envelope requirements.reducer profile ref.

relation_create_payload.description: Relation creation. The payload carries the whole relation object under `relation`: the registered effect_projection is set value = payload.relation, and event-and-patch.md 2.4.2 permits a projection to move an existing root path wholesale but never to assemble one, so a flat {relation_id, kind, from_ref, to_ref} form has no derivable cell value.

relation_tombstone_payload.description: Payload for ak.relation.tombstone. relation_id is the sole target carrier for the irreversible active -> tombstoned transition; target_ref and update-style patch fields are forbidden. When supplied, reason is retained on the Event and is not copied into the materialized Relation object.

expected_state_digest.description: Optional optimistic concurrency guard. When present it MUST equal the writer-observed digest of the frozen pre-state this patch was computed against; a mismatch MUST fail closed. Registered as the apply_patch projection's expected_prestate source in contract-registry.json.

resource_discovery_state_payload.description: State payload for actor, applet, and handle discovery declarations. resource_id is the stable cell subject; value carries the schema-versioned discovery state.

rsvp_encrypted_response.description: Encrypted RSVP response envelope. The content_type is pinned so a receiver can route the ciphertext to exactly one decrypted schema; the plaintext MUST validate against rsvp_response.

rsvp_entry.description: Complete RSVP cell value. The whole entry is the mv_register set value, so every head independently carries the schedule the responder observed plus the response itself.

schedule_basis_refs.description: Non-empty schedule revision frontier the responder actually observed, as event_digest values sorted in ascending canonical UTF-8 byte order. MUST be a subset of the envelope causal_refs[], which caps it at the same 128 entries. A frontier larger than 128 MUST fail closed with schedule_frontier_too_large rather than being truncated.

response.description: Plaintext response branch. Only admissible when the target Strand effective scope encryption floor permits plaintext and the receiving service declares the rsvp_response plaintext data class.

encrypted_response.description: Encrypted response branch; content_type is pinned to application/vnd.arkret.calendar-rsvp-response+json and the decrypted plaintext MUST validate against rsvp_response. Required when the effective scope encryption floor is e2ee_required.

rsvp_response.description: RSVP response object. Used directly by rsvp_entry.response and as the decrypted plaintext of rsvp_entry.encrypted_response, whose content_type is application/vnd.arkret.calendar-rsvp-response+json. status and comment always share one encryption boundary; a plaintext status with an encrypted comment is not a valid shape.

comment.description: Optional responder comment. An empty response is expressed by omitting the field, never by an empty string.

event_ref.description: Calendar event Strand id; encoded as a ak:strand: typed id.

occurrence.description: JSON null for the whole series, or the canonical recurrence instance key: YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events and YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[Zone] for timed events. The date component MUST be a real proleptic-Gregorian date, not merely match the digit pattern. The producer MUST canonicalize before signing; receivers MUST reject non-canonical keys instead of rewriting them.

schema_define_state_payload.description: Schema definition state payload. schema_id is the stable definition cell subject.

sidecar_create_payload.description: Create payload uses the Agent Sidecar object schema. It is emitted only by the atomic ak.self.agent.sidecar.command.ensure aggregate after the reducer/service derives and creates backing_circle_id; raw ensure callers never construct or submit this Event directly. The reducer MUST enforce one non-tombstoned Sidecar per (realm_id, controller_id), controller equality with the authenticated principal, exact same-batch backing Circle binding, and effective_scope=circle with circle_id equal to backing_circle_id.

sidecar_context_attach_payload.description: Controller-signed versioned attachment that projects one private Strand and its agent_sidecar_of Relation for an existing Sidecar.

sidecar_access_replace_payload.description: Controller-signed full-set Sidecar access replacement. Realm and backing-Circle scope are carried by the Event envelope.

control_frontier.description: Sorted accepted control refs that materialize the Sidecar and exact desired backing membership. Semantic validation requires UTF-8 byte-lexicographic order and equality with the current server-derived Sidecar MLS context.

sovereign_did_policy_state_payload.description: Sovereign DID policy state payload. trust_domain is the deployment-scoped replay-boundary subject.

space_create_payload.description: Create payload uses the full Space object schema for wire validation. Semantic validation MUST require payload.object.created_by to match the top-level actor_id and payload.object.created_at to match the top-level created_at before acceptance.

space_object_tombstone_payload.description: Payload for ak.space.tombstone. Realm tombstone uses its separate Realm lifecycle payload; Space tombstone targets payload.space_id.

space_patch_payload.description: Payload class for ak.space.update. Patches Space metadata (title, rank, kind-specific fields) on the Space identified by space_id. Per operations-sync.md §7.3 / §9.3 and realm-and-space.md §3.3, ak.space.update only mutates the Space's own metadata; it MUST NOT PATCH top-level state (archive/restore go through ak.space.archive / ak.space.restore) and MUST NOT move Strands (ak.strand.move / ak.strand.reorder). Reducer rejects update on a non-active Space (reason=space_not_active) — see conformance-vectors.md §6.7.

space_state_transition_payload.description: Payload for ak.space.archive and ak.space.restore. The target Space is expressed on payload.space_id; top-level target_ref is a rejected field on Event envelopes.

state_conflict_recovery_payload.description: Control cell bottom recovery. zh/authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md section 9.5 resolves a bottom=reject cell that has joined to Bottom back to a single legal value. The authorization and the pre-conflict anchor are not payload fields: they are refs[] entries with role=recovery_capability and role=state_witness.

target_cell.description: The cell being recovered. It MUST be in Bottom when the reducer applies this Event; on any other cell state the write MUST be rejected. This is the only registered kind whose write target is resolved from the payload rather than from a literal cell_family in the registry, because a recovery addresses one cell of an arbitrary family.

resolved_value.description: The single legal value the cell resolves to. Section 9.5 requires the Move to declare it, so it is signed payload, never reducer-synthesized.

strand_create_payload.description: Create payload uses the full Strand object schema for wire validation. Semantic validation MUST require payload.object.created_by to match the top-level actor_id and payload.object.created_at to match the top-level created_at before acceptance.

board_space_id.description: Board Space that owns the position edge; deduplication key (board_space_id, strand_id) MUST be unique among active edges.

from_space_id.description: Source List Space (optional; reducer infers from current active edge if omitted).

target_space_id.description: Target List Space after move. This is the ONLY payload-level field for the destination; the reducer compiles it into the cas_register cell value as 'list_space_id' on the cell at ak:cell:ak.component.strand.position.v1:<board_space_id>:<strand_id>. Writers MUST NOT put 'list_space_id' directly on the ak.strand.move payload (additionalProperties=false enforces this) — there is exactly one destination input field on the wire.

strand_patch_payload.description: Payload class for ak.strand.update. Patches ordinary Strand fields on the Strand identified by target_ref.

space_id.description: List Space within which the reorder happens.

strand_stage_set_payload.description: Payload class for ak.strand.stage.set. Mutates Strand.stage / Strand.stage_changed_at. Intentionally carries no reason field — see object_stage_set_payload description and zh/models/strand-and-message.md §3.2.

not.$comment: Mirror of object_stage_set_payload guard. Reason-style fields are forbidden; rationale belongs in a discussion-track Message.

strand_watch_set_payload.description: Payload for ak.strand.watch.set. Writes the (strand_id, watcher_actor_id) watch cell. The new cell value is computed from payload.level + payload.level_public: when level is null the effect is set null (clear, equivalent to mentions_only); when level is a string the effect is set { level, level_public? }. Reducer invariants: (1) watcher_actor_id MUST equal envelope.actor_id unless writer holds ak.strand.watch.set.others; (2) when watcher_actor_id != envelope.actor_id (.others write), level MUST be one of {mentions_only, participating, all} and level_public MUST be omitted or false — writing muted or level_public=true on behalf of another actor MUST failed_precondition; (3) .others writes MUST carry refs[role=audit_pair] to a same-batch ak.audit.accessed event whose payload access_kind=watch_set_others identifies writer / target / cell / before-after heads. See models/strand-and-message.md §8.4.

level.description: Watch level. Required. null clears the cell (equivalent to mentions_only / no record); in that case level_public MUST be omitted.

level_public.description: Opt-in publication of the level value to non-self projection consumers. Default false. muted MUST NOT be exposed even with level_public=true. MUST be omitted when level is null.

expected_value.description: Compiles to cas_register head_eq precondition. Whole-value compare against the cell pre-state: either null (assert no prior record) or { level, level_public? } matching the prior cell value exactly. When omitted, reducers MUST treat it as head_eq null: only the initial write may pass; an existing cell MUST fail_precondition. Omission MUST NOT disable CAS or imply last-write-wins.

allOf.description: level_public MUST be omitted when level is null (clearing a cell does not carry a public-level setting).

track_name.description: Strand track key for Message payloads. Mirrors message.schema.json#/properties/track_name: v1 Message payloads are restricted to 'discussion'.

verification_method.description: DID URL of a concrete verification method. Bare DIDs are not valid where a key binding is required.

expected_state_digest.description: Optional optimistic concurrency guard. When present it MUST equal the writer-observed digest of the frozen pre-state this patch was computed against; a mismatch MUST fail closed. Registered as the apply_patch projection's expected_prestate source in contract-registry.json.

view_reconcile_payload.description: Payload for ak.view.reconcile. view_id is the ak.component.view.reconcile.v1 cell subject; definition is the whole View definition object being synced (zh/models/views.md section 3.2). Reconcile is neither ak.view.create's object snapshot nor ak.view.update's patch: it replaces the definition wholesale, so it MUST NOT be dispatched to the shared view_payload, whose definition branch does not even require view_id.
